name: CCA 105 装没听清许可 跑道入侵

cards.audioText:
B: You are the pilot of Air China 105 and now waiting for ATC clearance.
C: Air China 105 is cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
B: The tower controllers voice is disturbed, and you didn't hear the words after 9200 meters, ask the controller to repeat the latter part of the instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你是 Air China 105 的飞行员，现在等待 ATC 许可。
C: Air China 105 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
B: 塔台管制员声音受干扰，你没有听到 9200 米之后的话，请管制员重复指令后半部分。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA105, say again after 9200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA105，请重复 9200 米之后内容。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, cruising level 9200 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，巡航高度 9200 米，Lima Kilo Oscar 1 Delta 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzho via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, LKO 1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，LKO 1D 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed the relevant checklist, ask the Tower controller to let you to start your engine.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已完成相关检查单，请求塔台管制员允许你起动发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA105, request startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA105，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, startup is approved, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，开车批准，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Start up approved, call you ready for taxi, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 开车批准，准备滑行时呼叫你，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi out, ask the Tower controller for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑出，向塔台管制员请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA105, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA105，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, taxi via taxiway Alpha 7 and Alpha to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，经滑行道 Alpha 7 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A7 and A to holding point of runway 36R, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA105。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 105, hold position, traffic ten o'clock, approaching you from your left.
B: Acknowledge the instruction, and inform the controller that you have seen the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，原地等待，交通在 10 点钟方向，从你左侧接近。
B: 确认指令，并通知管制员你已看到该交通。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, traffic in sight, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，看到交通，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: Later, you are approaching the active runway 36R, ask the Tower controller for permission to enter the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，你接近使用中的跑道 36R，向塔台管制员请求进入跑道许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA105, approaching runway 36R, request line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA105，接近跑道 36R，请求进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，CCA105。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, cleared for take off runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，跑道 36R 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for take off runway 36R, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: This is a night operation. When you are running out your speed has just retrieved V R, you suddenly see a slow moving object ahead of you, it is crossing the runway from left to right. You pull backs and rotate to avoid the traffic, and you felt a shake from the nose gear. You get airborne at time 23, and report the accident to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 这是夜间运行。当你加速滑跑速度刚到 VR 时，突然看到前方有一个缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。你拉杆抬轮避让该交通，并感觉前起落架震动。你在 23 分离地，向武汉进近报告事故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, airborne at time 23, we encountered runway incursion during take off, a slow moving object ahead of us, it is crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，23 分离地，我们起飞时遭遇跑道侵入，前方有缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 105, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, is there any damage to the aircraft? report your intentions.
B: Tell the Approach controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport, and you don't know about any damage.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，武汉进近，雷达识别，飞机是否受损？报告你的意图。
B: 告诉进近管制员你想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不知道是否有损伤。
cards.referenceText: We want to land at Wuhan Airport, and we are not sure about any damage, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不确定是否有损伤，CCA105。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 105, roger, do you want to hold and have a check?
B: Tell the controller that you do want to hold and check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，收到，你想等待并检查吗？
B: 告诉管制员你确实想等待并检查。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，CCA105。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to Delta Alpha and hold over Delta Alpha.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 Delta Alpha 并在 Delta Alpha 上空等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to DA and hold over DA, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 DA 并在 DA 上空等待，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you found out that there is something wrong with the nose gear, tell the controller you need to dump fuel before landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你发现前起落架有问题，告诉管制员着陆前需要放油。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, we have something wrong with the nose gear, request dump fuel before landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，我们前起落架有问题，请求着陆前放油。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, radar vector to the dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，雷达引导至放油区。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: Later, inform the controller that you have finished the fuel dumping and want to be radar guided to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，通知管制员你已完成放油，并希望雷达引导至 Wuhan Airport。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，放油完成，请求雷达引导至 Wuhan。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach runway 36L, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近，CCA105。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 105, do you need any assistance upon landing?
B: Tell the controller that you are going to make a landing without nose gear, you need fire trucks and a foamed runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 105，着陆时你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道。
cards.referenceText: We are going to land without the nose gear, we need fire trucks and a foamed runway, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道，CCA105。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, foamed runway and fire trucks will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，铺泡沫跑道和消防车将在着陆时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA105。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, reduce speed to 180 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，减速到 180 节。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 180 knots, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速到 180 节，CCA105。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 105, turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 105，左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, report established, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告，CCA105。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have captured the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你已截获航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA105, ILS established.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA105，ILS 已建立。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Air China 105, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, 13 miles from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，Air China 105，可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，距接地点 13 海里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36L, 124.35, CCA105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，124.35，CCA105。
